Long afternoon helpful news for everyone using the desk
Please read this before you travel

Travel notice for pet passengers

Travelers should check their animal documents, carrier fit, and airport arrival plans before going to the airport. We are sorry for any confusion, and we want to make the steps as clear as possible.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is here to help with the basic travel rules for pets and service animals. <<FACT F072>> Please keep your paperwork ready, and make sure every form is clean, readable, and matches the traveler and animal details. If anything is missing, the trip may be delayed while the issue is fixed.

For larger animals, the health certificate must be current and accepted before check-in. <<FACT F081>> The passenger coordinator can explain what to bring, what to expect at the desk, and how to prepare the pet for a safe handoff. We ask travelers to speak promptly and respectfully so we can help without delay.

If you are unsure about any step, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you leave for the airport.
